FxCommon_SelectRoomVariant sets it to 0xFF when game flag 0x40000000 is set (else 0); FxCommon_InitScene then sets up the fog layer from TIM entry 1 instead of 0, as main's Draw pipeline picks fog source [1] on the same flag.
Start preset 7 in FxCommon_InitScene samples path selectedMotion + 1 for the target, then path selectedMotion for the position and copies it to g_FxCommonCameraPathIndex.

FxCommon_DrawSceneNodes draws the tinted (mode 1, depth bias 800) copies of the route and paired nodes only while it is 1; FxCommon_StepEffects sets it on view and page changes and clears it when the play frame reaches the setup's value30.
FxCommon_StepEffects only handles the play, exit and page inputs of view mode 0 while it is 0 and clears it when view modes 1 and 2 start; no code in the overlay sets it.
FxCommon_StepEffects sets it to 1 when view mode 1 starts its tail-path camera move (pad bit 0x20) and to 0 when the mode is skipped to 2; mode 2 then picks the marker fade from it.

Record view (16-byte FxCommonMotionRecord) of g_FxCommonMotionWhole: FxCommon_SnapMotionWhole stores the ten sampled path points << 16 there and FxCommon_BeginMotionBlend reads them to compute the deltas.
Y lane of g_FxCommonMotionPositions (+4): FxCommon_InitScene stores each sampled y << 16 through it.
Z lane of g_FxCommonMotionPositions (+8): FxCommon_StepMotionBlend walks it with x at -8 and y at -4, adding the deltas; FxCommon_InitScene stores z << 16 through it.
Byte view of g_FxCommonMotionDeltas (same address): FxCommon_StepMotionBlend adds the word at this + 16 * i to the x lane.
Byte view of g_FxCommonMotionDeltas + 4: FxCommon_StepMotionBlend adds it to the y lane.
Byte view of g_FxCommonMotionDeltas + 8: FxCommon_StepMotionBlend adds it to the z lane.
